name: Jair
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob and called it after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

note.label: Deuteronomy 3: The Battle Is the Lord's

points: Zadok and Abiathar were the priests, and Ira the Jairite was a chief ruler about David. Do not read merely to say you read four chapters; read and truly study to give the sense and understand the scriptures.
The record follows Hezron into Gilead and names Segub and Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
